_meta.description: BioDockify AI Engine — local model catalog. Adding a new model here requires NO code changes. Each model is described declaratively; the installer, status API, and presets system read from this file.
_meta.pharma_note: Every model in this catalog must be suitable for pharmaceutical research workflows: literature synthesis, claim verification, ICH compliance checks, mechanism explanation, ADMET interpretation. Models that fail at structured pharma tasks should NOT be added here.

bonsai-8b.description: Natively trained 1-bit LLM. 1.15 GB parameter memory — fits on virtually any GPU. Recommended for student laptops, air-gapped labs, and offline pharmaceutical research workflows. 64K context window.
bonsai-8b.pharma_fit: Default BioDockify AI Engine model for private pharma research. Suitable for: literature review drafting, ICH/CONSORT compliance checks, claim extraction, mechanism-of-action explanation, ADMET result interpretation, thesis section scaffolding.

runtime.temperature_rationale: Low temperature for reproducible pharma outputs (claim verification, citation checks).

bonsai-27b._comment: Reserved for future addition. 27B class is heavier (3.5GB+ GGUF) — power-user option, not default. Add when Model Manager UI lands.
